summary: DockClock Driver Expo app + backend driver endpoints tested. Backend 13/13 pytest pass (open landing page valid/invalid, GET driver, ping far/no-event, geofence arrival via ping, tap arrive/depart incl. 400 guards, BOL octet-stream+bol.jpg accepted via mimetype inference, non-image rejected, 422 on bad body). Frontend (390x844 web preview, Playwright geolocation): home title/input/open button, invalid input error, https://host/api/open/<tok> and raw token both navigate to /d/<tok>; on-site RL-55018 shows load number, gps chip, start card, facility, on-site timer, stop row, I'm leaving, BOL button; completed APX-30277 shows driver-all-done; invalid token shows driver-link-error. Start trip -> foreground watch, chip 'GPS on · ±10 m · precise · keep the app open', pings reached backend, moving to stop coords triggered geofence arrival (arrived_source=geofence) and UI switched to on-site timer. Manual arrive/depart taps work (driver_tap). Trip resume after reload of '/' redirects to active load. Ping throttle verified (20s or 25m cumulative; big move pings immediately). Web BOL upload via file chooser works (count 1). /api/open page renders open-app-button with dockclock:// deep link, install steps, pending notice; invalid shows open-invalid. FOUND & FIXED 1 bug: Uncaught Error overlay 'The wake lock with tag dockclock has not activated yet' when load delivered (stopTracking called un-awaited deactivateKeepAwake inside try/catch -> unhandled promise rejection). No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av/barcode-scanner/background-fetch) found. Native-only items (background task, precise prompt, camera, map) not testable on web.

minor.issue: Invalid token returns HTTP 200 (open-invalid HTML). Acceptable for UX, but 404 status would be more accurate.
Install steps say 'using the button below' even when no DRIVER_APP_IOS_URL/ANDROID_URL is set (only the pending notice shows). Copy should adapt when store URLs are missing.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: deactivateKeepAwake() returns a rejecting Promise when wake lock wasn't active; sync try/catch didn't catch it -> red 'Uncaught Error' overlay after final departure tap. Now awaited. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/tracking.ts:135

integration_issues.flow: Manual tap completion while another load's trip is active
integration_issues.issue: tap() calls stopTracking('delivered') whenever this load's stops are all departed, without checking the active trip token. If the driver is tracking load A and taps through load B, A's tracking is stopped and the trip cleared. Guard with (await getTrip())?.token === token. Reference: /app/frontend/app/d/[token].tsx:142

integration_issues.flow: Start trip on a second load
integration_issues.issue: startTracking silently replaces an existing trip for a different load (no warning). Consider confirming or auto-stopping only if previous load is delivered. Reference: /app/frontend/src/lib/tracking.ts:108

issues: Toast renders over the header (covers logo/load number) for ~3s after taps; minor.

action_items: Guard stopTracking in tap() so it only stops the trip belonging to the current token ([token].tsx:142).
Optional: warn before Start trip replaces an active trip for another load.
Optional: /api/open install copy when no store URLs configured; consider 404 status for invalid token.

Native build verification needed: background location task (TaskManager), expo-location/next FULL accuracy prompt on iOS, Android fine-location re-ask, camera BOL upload via expo/fetch on file:// URIs (backend now accepts octet-stream + bol.jpg).

Security note: resolveApi trusts any *.emergentagent.com / *.emergent.host host from the link's api param; a crafted link could send driver GPS to another app on those domains. Consider exact-host allowlist only.
critical_code_review_comments: tracking.ts:135 un-awaited async call inside try/catch (fixed).
[token].tsx is 432 lines - ok. No raw HTML elements; all text wrapped in Text; testIDs present on interactive elements.
server.py driver_url (/loads/{id}) and SMS (/loads/{id}/sms) now build {app_url}/api/open/{token} (lines 510, 576) - correct per code review (Clerk auth not tested).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows after fix (1 bug fixed, 1 integration edge-case reported)

seed_data_creation: No reseed. Tests clone RL-55018 into temporary TEST_ loads (id prefix TEST_, unarrived stop) directly in mongo and delete them (plus pings/invoices/files) afterwards. Demo loads unchanged.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_driver_app.py (pytest.ini forces -n 2 loadscope; use -n0 for serial). Fixture clones RL-55018 (token b8dbdcc3...) - if demo is reseeded update ON_SITE_TOKEN/COMPLETED_TOKEN. For UI geofence tests use page.context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + set_geolocation; stop coords 34.049,-117.435 radius 300m. Frontend backend URL env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.
rca_of_issue: Uncaught 'wake lock with tag dockclock has not activated yet': expo-keep-awake deactivateKeepAwake is async and on web throws ERR_KEEP_AWAKE_TAG_INVALID when the tag isn't active (e.g. manual-tap delivery without Start, or after reload where activation didn't happen). The call was not awaited, so try/catch didn't catch the rejection -> dev error overlay. Fix: await it inside try. Verified: full arrive->depart->all-done flow produced no pageerror.
